VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms 64 tests pass and the package.json diff (ATT) confirms no new dependencies—so criteria as literally evidenced appear satisfied. However, the core task is fixing a *race condition*, and the attested evidence does not demonstrate this. Passing tests only show the bug is fixed if a test specifically reproduces the race (timing/concurrency), which is notoriously hard to capture. There is no admissible evidence (no failing-then-passing regression test targeting the race, no proof of the guard's correctness under concurrency) showing criterion (1) is actually met. The "small guard" claim is SELF and not corroborated for the specific concurrency defect, so I cannot confirm the race is genuinely resolved.
